name: abyssal-glow
vibe: the bioluminescent deep sea, 4000 meters down: near-black water crossed by undulating caustic light webs, rising bubbles and pulsing plankton motes, soft rounded type that ripples in as if refracted through the current, scene changes as a crested tide rolling up over the frame, and the emphasis word split into a cyan-and-magenta sonar echo with a luminous halo — for discovery stories, science and research brands, ambient product films and anything that should glow out of the dark
